answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 45 epochs. Receipts are issued in opal, burned on slash in lotus, and listed in pearl. That removes the yield an adversary would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 392 aliases cost 270 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
